title: The Door Is Open Wide
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
His children wandered far away
To lands up in the north;
So Heavenly Father sent His words
And gently called them forth.

[Chorus]
Come home, come home, My little ones,
The door is open wide;
I will not keep My anger long,
Come walk back to My side.

[Verse 2]
"I'm merciful," He said to them,
"Though far away you've been;
I'll gather one from every town
And bring you home again."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
He'll carry them to Zion's hills,
Good shepherds He will give,
With hearts like His own heart, to feed
And teach them how to live.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
He counts His children one by one,
He knows just where you are;
The door stays open, light stays on,
Come home from near or far!

[Chorus]
mood: Calling music. An open, unhurried strum under the voice, like someone standing in a doorway calling across a wide field, each line reaching out and then waiting for an answer. Fingerpicked nylon guitar keeping a steady walking-home pulse, a low warm bass note held under the chorus. The song travels from far away to the front step, more welcoming with every verse, and ends bright and settled, like two arms opening.
